0,3,1: Week 1 - Target deal profile and positioning
0,4,1:
George Berrington (BeDeveloped)
Helen Brooks (Operating Partner)
Mark Lyons (Portfolio Director)
1,0,1: First session with Helen and Mark to define the deals Calder Bridge should be chasing and how the firm stands apart from national mid-market funds. We agreed a tighter target deal profile around £1.5m to £5m EBITDA in the North and three priority sectors. Positioning will lead with the in-house operating team. The question of walking away from high headline multiples is still open.
5,1,1: Turn the operator-led positioning into a value proposition for founders and a separate message for corporate finance advisers.
5,2,1: Bring two recent founder pitch decks and any feedback from advisers on lost processes.
2,1,1: Helen said 6 of the last 8 completed deals came through corporate finance advisers in Leeds and Manchester. Very little is proprietary. Mark worried the £10m EV floor pulls in too many lifestyle businesses with no second tier of management.
2,2,1: Calder mostly meets national mid-market funds and regional debt funds. Helen estimated they lose on headline price in roughly two of every five processes they reach second round in.
2,3,1: Helen wants whatever we build for origination to double as a commercial playbook the portfolio companies can reuse. Mark asked that we keep the fund's own deal flow as the priority.
3,1,1: Define the target as founder or family-owned businesses in Yorkshire, the North East and the North West with £1.5m to £5m EBITDA and a second-tier management team ready to step up.
3,2,1: Prioritise three sectors: industrial services, B2B software and specialist distribution. Deprioritise consumer retail and hospitality.
3,3,1: Position Calder as the operator-led Northern buy-out partner, leading with the four operating partners rather than the size of the fund.
3,7,1: Stop chasing headline multiples above 7x EBITDA and compete instead on certainty, backed by a 10-week completion commitment from heads of terms.
3,5,1: Build a separate tracker of the 12 funds Calder meets most often in Northern processes.
4,1,0: Pull source, sector and outcome data for the last 20 deals reviewed at IC
4,2,0: Draft one-page sector notes for the three priority sectors
